text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Grand Concert ends to great fanfare, capping off a night of electric emotions and song that brought us all closer together under one spotlight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later, students are practicing for their winning concerts with vigor—even the backup dancer parts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Grand Concert helped them realize that they want to dance with a smile, no matter where they stand on stage. For their fans' sake.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Light Hello drops by with a photo in hand. She's decided to use a group shot of everyone smiling as a poster for next year's Grand Concert.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The space we created for runners and fans to converse through song can't end as a one-time thing. Hello firmly declares her intent to forge a new tradition.
